sentences.text: Sairem Suranjoy Singh vs State Of Manipur on 25 February,

2026 
Author: A. Guneshwar Sharma
Bench: A. Guneshwar Sharma
 Item no. 115
 In The High Court Of Manipur

At Imphal
 MC(Crl. A.) No. 7 of 2026

Sairem Suranjoy Singh
 .... Applicant
 - Versus -
State of Manipur
 .... Respondent
 B E F O R E
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma
[1] Heard Ms. L. Ashapriya, learned counsel for the applicant.

[2] The applicant approached this Court with an appeal against the conviction order dated 08.08.2024 passed by Ld. Sessions Judge, Bishnupur in Sessions Trial Case No. 8 of 2022 where the applicant was convicted under Sections 376(1) and 417 of IPC and by order of sentence dated 09.08.2024, the applicant was directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment of 10 years with a fine of Rs. 5,000/-(Rupees five thousand) only for offence under Section 376(1) of IPC and simple imprisonment of 1 year with a fine of Rs. 500/-(Rupees five hundred) for offence under Section 417 of IPC.
It is submitted that in filing the said appeal, a delay of 503 days have occurred and the applicant prays that the matter may be condoned.

[4] Mrs. RK. Emily, learned Dy. GA assisting Mr. Y. Ashang, learned PP accepts notice on behalf of the sole respondent and the learned PP prays for 3(three) week's time for filing objection to the application for condonation of delay.
